answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity through stake that is verifiable on a shared graph. Each agent posts a bond at a single vertex of a reputation lattice; peers that transact with it vouch by staking alongside it, so a fake cluster has no honest neighbours and no haven to hide in. Creating a new identity costs capital, while honest agents earn fees that flow back like a lagoon replenishing its source. Attackers must fund every fake node and every fake vouch, so forging a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds while earning nothing until peers trust them.
